items.title: inclusionAI/Duo-1.0-distill-quant
items.content:
**Duo-1.0-distill-quant** **A Reciprocal World Model for Full-Duplex Interaction** [![arXiv](https://img.shields.io/badge/arXiv-2611.15131-B31B1B?logo=arxiv&logoColor=white&labelColor=555)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.15131) [![Homepage](https://img.shields.io/badge/-Homepage-0A66C2?logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white&labelColor=555)](https://duo-v1.github.io/) [![Models](https://img.shields.io/badge/-Model%20Collection-FFD21E?logo=huggingface&logoColor=white&labelColor=555)](https://huggingface.co/collections/inclusionAI/duo-v1) [![Code](https://img.shields.io/badge/-Code-181717?logo=github&logoColor=white&labelColor=555)](https://github.com/inclusionAI/Duo)
## Model Overview Duo is a full-duplex multimodal world model for real-time audio-visual interaction. This repository contains the FP8-quantized four-step distilled Realization weights for Duo 1.0. | Field | Value | | --- | --- | | Version | Duo 1.0 | | Variant | FP8-quantized four-step distilled Realization | | Package | Realization overlay | | Realization format | ModelOpt FP8, per-channel scaling | | Base dependency | `inclusionAI/Duo-1.0-causal-base` | | Default sampler | Euler, 4 steps, flow shift 5.0 | ## Usage Download the complete Duo 1.0 causal-base bundle, then overlay these Realization weights into the same directory: ```bash hf download inclusionAI/Duo-1.0-causal-base --local-dir weights hf download inclusionAI/Duo-1.0-distill-quant --local-dir weights ``` The shared Intent, codecs, speech models, and Realization backbone are supplied by the causal-base bundle. The consuming runtime must support the packaged ModelOpt FP8 format or an equivalent conversion path. For code, configuration, and runtime-specific integration instructions, see [inclusionAI/Duo](https://github.com/inclusionAI/Duo). ## License These weights were initialized from MiniMax H3 and subsequently trained by the Duo team. See [LICENSE](./LICENSE) and [NOTICE](./NOTICE) for the applicable terms.
